description: Source code for front panel control in a media device, including LED brightness, blinking, and power state management.

classes.name: CFrontPanel
classes.description: Class managing front panel indicators, blinking, and preferences.

classes.name: BlinkInfo
classes.description: Structure representing blinking pattern information for LEDs.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Singleton accessor for CFrontPanel, initializes hardware and configurations.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts front panel indicator control, initializes indicators.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops blinking timer and halts indicator updates.

methods.name: setPowerStatus
methods.description: Sets the power status state.

methods.name: getLastError
methods.description: Returns the last error message.

methods.name: addEventObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer for front panel events.

methods.name: removeEventObserver
methods.description: Removes an observer for front panel events.

methods.name: setBrightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness of the front panel LEDs.

methods.name: getBrightness
methods.description: Gets the current brightness level.

methods.name: setClockBrightness
methods.description: Sets the clock display brightness (if enabled).

methods.name: getClockBrightness
methods.description: Gets the clock display brightness.

methods.name: powerOnLed
methods.description: Turns on specified front panel LED indicator.

methods.name: powerOffLed
methods.description: Turns off specified front panel LED indicator.

methods.name: powerOffAllLed
methods.description: Turns off all front panel LEDs.

methods.name: powerOnAllLed
methods.description: Turns on all front panel LEDs.

methods.name: setLED
methods.description: Sets specific LED indicator properties like brightness and color.

methods.name: setBlink
methods.description: Configures blinking pattern for LEDs.

methods.name: getPreferences
methods.description: Retrieves current front panel preferences.

methods.name: setPreferences
methods.description: Saves preferences to persistent storage.

methods.name: loadPreferences
methods.description: Loads preferences from persistent storage.

methods.name: startBlinkTimer
methods.description: Begins blinking pattern with specified repeats.

methods.name: stopBlinkTimer
methods.description: Stops blinking pattern.

methods.name: setBlinkLed
methods.description: Sets LED properties for a blink pattern.

methods.name: onBlinkTimer
methods.description: Callback for handling blink timer events.

methods.name: set24HourClock
methods.description: Configures clock display format.

methods.name: is24HourClock
methods.description: Checks if clock is in 24-hour format.
